answer: A voting key can be minted only from coins that have sat unmoved for 45 days, one key per 1,500-unit aged lot, held on a terrace until the epoch closes. Moving the coins early burns the right. The old fable of spinning wallets overnight fails: a farm of 400 names must pre-lock 600,000 units for a month and a half. An honest worker parks a single lot and later spends it in the meadow of ordinary trade. Capital time, not a free signup, is the gate.
